returns.name: Form OQ, Oregon Quarterly Tax Report
contents: Due with the calendar's quarterly dates for every employer (the report is filed whether the employer deposits monthly, semi-weekly or quarterly); quarterly depositors pay with it.
Filed through Frances Online; after filing, employers can pay the reported employer taxes by ACH through the Department of Revenue payment portal.
Q4 2025 also carries Form OA (annual reconciliation), Form OR-STT-2 if necessary, the 2025 W-2 and Form OR-WR, all due February 2, 2026.

notModelled: The thresholds that make an employer monthly, quarterly or semi-weekly: not in the stored documents.
The Q4 2026 and all 2027 calendar rows: the 2026 calendar ends at the Q3 date; later pay dates draw state_calendar_not_published.
Paid Leave Oregon contributions (Oregon Employment Department): not deposited with the Department of Revenue and not read here.
The Statewide Transit Tax (OR-STT-2), the Oregon Workers' Benefit Fund assessment, and Portland, TriMet and Lane transit/local taxes.

deposits.interpretation: Oregon's 2026 Withholding and Transit Tax Calendar prints the due date of every MONTHLY-depositor payment (payroll of one month is due the 15th of the next, rolled forward: February 16, March 16, April 15, May 15, June 15, July 15, August 17, September 15, October 15, November 16, December 15; December 2025 payroll January 15), every QUARTERLY-depositor payment with Form OQ (Q4 2025 February 2, Q1 April 30, Q2 July 31, Q3 November 1), and the SEMI-WEEKLY rule: payroll on Wednesday, Thursday or Friday is due the following Wednesday, Saturday to Tuesday the following Friday. The stored documents do not say how an employer becomes a monthly, quarterly or semi-weekly depositor, so the frequency is an INPUT and is never derived. The monthly and quarterly dates are held as the agency's printed 2026 calendar (pay dates in any other year draw state_calendar_not_published); the printed Q3 date of November 1, 2026 (a Sunday) is used as printed and should be confirmed against the PDF. The semi-weekly dates follow the printed rule for any year.

channels.description: Frances Online (Oregon Employment Department and Department of Revenue combined payroll reporting); payment portal by ACH, Revenue Online for credit cards; 1099s are filed through iWire
enrollment: Register through the Oregon Business Registry (allow up to 14 business days) or with the Combined Employer's Registration; each payroll account has a BIN.
Pension and annuity withholding needs a different BIN than the payroll account.

returns.name: Quarterly combined payroll report (Form OQ) and Paid Leave Oregon, workers' benefit fund and UI tax
contents: Quarterly reports are due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31, the same as federal Form 941; a weekend or holiday moves the date to the next day that is not one.
Certain smaller agricultural and domestic (in-home) employers may file annually.
Employers who file after the due date, file incorrectly formatted reports or fail to pay on time may be charged penalties and interest.

notModelled: The Employment Department's own pages were not read; the guide is the Secretary of State's.
The Oregon guide labels this as a combined payroll report; which lines belong to UI versus Paid Leave Oregon and the Workers' Benefit Fund assessment was not parsed.
